title: Liability Already Charged on the Same Loss, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite Signed Claims
content:
**Rule.** For a signed lost or stolen card claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan, the liability already charged on the same loss is counted on the loss's claims resolved with an error found, each at its disputed amount. These count before any claim still under investigation, whatever their posting order.

- A claim's loss is the set of the account's unauthorized-transaction claims carrying its loss date.
- The loss counts as reported on the date of the account's single lost or stolen replacement order placed on or after the loss date, among its orders of the last 12 months.
- The report is late when it came more than 2 business days after the loss date. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

| The loss carries claims resolved with an error found | Report | Liability already charged |
|---|---|---|
| yes | late (more than 2 business days) | the lesser of their total disputed amount and 500.00 |
| yes | not late (2 business days or fewer) | the lesser of their total disputed amount and 50.00 |
| no | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A loss carries two claims resolved with an error found, disputed at 18.40 and 22.75, and the report was not late. The liability already charged is 41.15, below 50.00.
- The same two claims with resolved disputes of 38.00 and 29.60 and a timely report: 50.00, the lesser of 67.60 and 50.00.
- With a late report, those same two claims give 67.60, below 500.00.
- A loss whose other claims are all still under investigation: nothing.
